name: ai-center-planner
description: Motion-style routine organizer for the AI Center vault

scripts.package: npm run build:helper && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --dir
scripts.install-app: npm run package && npm run sign && rm -rf '/Applications/AI Center Planner.app' '/Applications/AI Center.app' && cp -R 'dist/mac-arm64/AI Center.app' /Applications/
scripts.build:icon: swift scripts/make-icon.swift build/icon.png && rm -rf build/icon.iconset && mkdir build/icon.iconset && for s in 16 32 128 256 512; do sips -z $s $s build/icon.png --out build/icon.iconset/icon_${s}x${s}.png >/dev/null && sips -z $((s*2)) $((s*2)) build/icon.png --out build/icon.iconset/icon_${s}x${s}@2x.png >/dev/null; done && iconutil -c icns build/icon.iconset -o build/icon.icns && rm -rf build/icon.iconset
scripts.build:helper: mkdir -p resources && xcrun swiftc -O -o resources/calendar-helper native/calendar-helper/main.swift
